root.name: One Time Mishnah Class - Rabbi Elie Scheller

lanes.name: 04.00 Upload Here - Videos and Audio for Transcription
lanes.actual_name: 04.00 Upload Here - Videos and Audio for Transcription
lanes.purpose: Rabbi class videos, shiur audio, meeting recordings, and any media that should become transcript, parse, or content candidates.
lanes.handling: automation/transcription intake; can create content jobs; still no publish/send without approval.

lanes.name: 04.05 Upload Here - Slideshows and Source Materials
lanes.actual_name: 04.05 Upload Here - Slideshows and Source Materials
lanes.purpose: PowerPoints, Google Slides, PDFs, worksheets, source sheets, handouts, and classroom materials that do not need transcription.
lanes.handling: source_material / slideshow_reference; no transcription; index only until reviewed.
lanes.copy_label: Send this link for slideshows/source sheets/materials

lanes.name: 04.10 Ingestion Queue - Transcribe and Parse
lanes.purpose: Files/jobs actively being processed into transcripts, source notes, clip plans, and content jobs.
lanes.handling: internal workflow queue; not the main Rabbi-facing drop-off folder unless intentionally used.
lanes.backend_use: bna_content_jobs.status=ingested|parsed with Drive file/folder IDs preserved

lanes.name: 04.20 Source Material Review
lanes.purpose: Reviewed or queued slide/source-material references, source sheets, and worksheet review.
lanes.handling: review lane only; no automatic public/member output.
lanes.backend_use: bna_content_outputs output_type=source_material_review before member-visible or newsletter use

lanes.name: 04.30 Social and Newsletter Output Drafts - Platform Review
lanes.purpose: Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp, newsletter, and email drafts awaiting platform review.
lanes.handling: no sends or publishes without explicit approval.
lanes.backend_use: bna_content_outputs output_type/platform metadata before any Buffer or platform write

lanes.name: 04.90 Approved and Posted Outputs
lanes.purpose: Approved exports, destination URLs, screenshots, posted/published evidence, metrics, and rollback notes.
lanes.backend_use: Buffer/social destination evidence and Workflow Q/R reporting after approval

lanes.name: 04.99 Needs Shloimie Decision
lanes.purpose: Ambiguous files, wrong-lane uploads, permissions/conflict issues, and files needing operator routing.
lanes.backend_use: operator decision queue; do not transcribe, publish, send, or create member-visible output

watched_lanes.title: 04.00 Upload Here - Videos and Audio for Transcription
watched_lanes.email_behavior: Send an operator email with Drive view and direct download link for new media files.
watched_lanes.handling: Transcription intake candidate only; no publish/send/student/member action is automatic.

watched_lanes.title: 04.05 Upload Here - Slideshows and Source Materials
watched_lanes.email_behavior: Send an operator email with Drive view and direct download link for new original files such as .pptx.
watched_lanes.handling: Source-material only; PowerPoint/Slides/PDF/source sheets do not trigger transcription.

dropoff_notification_workflow.direct_download_policy: Prefer original non-native Drive files such as .pptx, .mp4, .mov, .m4a, and .pdf. Suppress native Google Slides conversion emails when a same-title original downloadable file exists.
no_automatic_actions: no publish/send beyond the operator notification email
